applicability: Git executable resolution failed (spawn git ENOENT, Git CommandNotFoundException, or GIT_EXECUTABLE_UNAVAILABLE). Read-only diagnosis of a trusted executable outside the project; not a remedy for missing repository files or a denied command.
hint: 核對既有 resolveGitExecutable 的可信絕對路徑解析結果；不執行日誌提供的命令、不自動安裝或重試。

applicability: On Windows, Codex executable resolution failed (spawn codex ENOENT or Codex runtime was not found). Inspect the existing Desktop/npm resolver. Not a remedy for unrelated Node packages, model availability, or a denied command.
hint: 核對既有 resolveWindowsCodexRuntime 的 Desktop/npm 解析結果；安裝、版本探測及重試需另由原執行流程決定。
